name: particle-field
title: Particle Field
description: Dust drifting through a beam of light: soft particles at three depths, the near ones larger and brighter, all moving slowly sideways and bobbing. WebGL points; a CSS poster of scattered motes stands in elsewhere.

meta.reducedMotion: The particles, still (one WebGL frame), or the poster.
meta.useWhen: Cinema, projection, workshops, old rooms, archives, snowfall or pollen: a quiet atmosphere behind a dark hero.
meta.avoidWhen: "Tech" or "data" decoration; as a starfield warp; behind text-heavy sections; on pages that already run WebGL. For a cursor-reactive grid use Dot Field.
